# FounderVoice AI

> A free AI speech coach. You record sixty seconds of ordinary speech in the
> browser and get your speaking pace, filler-word rate, pause length, clarity
> and vocal energy measured, along with the single habit costing you the most
> and a drill to fix it. Ten recordings every 24 hours, no account and no card.

FounderVoice measures delivery rather than grammar or accent. It is aimed at
non-native English speakers, founders preparing pitches, and anyone who needs
to sound clearer under pressure. Transcription runs on Whisper; the analysis
(pace, fillers, pauses, clarity, pitch range) is computed from the audio.

Reference numbers used throughout the site, for anyone citing them:

- Comfortable speaking pace: 130 to 150 words per minute. Comprehension drops
  above roughly 170 wpm; attention drifts below roughly 110 wpm.
- Filler words: under 3 per minute reads as normal speech; above 8 per minute
  is what listeners remember instead of the point.
- Pauses: confident speakers pause 0.5 to 1.5 seconds at the end of a thought.
- Accent has little effect on perceived competence; pace, pauses and clarity
  carry most of it.

## Guides

- [How to Improve English Communication Skills](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-improve-english-communication-skills): A measurable method using your own recordings, with a two-week plan.
- [How to Speak with Confidence](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-speak-with-confidence): The four delivery behaviours listeners read as confidence, and how to change each.
- [How to Stop Using Filler Words](https://foundervoice.app/guides/how-to-stop-using-filler-words): Why fillers appear, and the replace-with-silence method that reduces them.
- [Ideal Speaking Pace (Words Per Minute)](https://foundervoice.app/guides/ideal-speaking-pace-words-per-minute): What pace to target, how to measure it, and how to slow down without drawling.
- [How to Practise a Startup Pitch](https://foundervoice.app/guides/pitch-practice-for-founders): Rehearsing delivery rather than slides, and the numbers investors respond to.
